names: Mission Bay Future Parks -- P9 (active recreation)
summary: San Francisco Recreation and Parks describes parcels P7 and P9, under I-280 along Mission Bay Drive and Owens Street, as currently undeveloped and anticipated to house active uses such as a skate park, pickleball courts and a ballfield, fully funded through OCII, with construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030.

milestones.text: Design-team selection process under way: per Rec and Park's August 2025 update, the developer (Mission Bay Development Group) released a request for qualifications in early August 2025 and expected to select a design team by mid-October
Rec and Park's October 2026 update says the developer is surveying the public on skate features and that the new skate and roll space is likely to go on parcels P9 and P7
Construction expected to begin ('Late 2028') for the P7 and P9 active recreation parks, per Rec and Park's project page
Parks expected to open to the public ('Early 2030') per Rec and Park's project page
milestones.basis_note: Rec and Park's project page gives 'Early 2030' for the P7/P9 parks together; a schedule for the project, not a permit or contract date

facts.value: Active recreation: a skate park, pickleball courts and a ballfield are anticipated (Rec and Park project page; shared by P7 and P9)
Design and construction fully funded through OCII (no amount stated on the page)
San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (will own and operate on completion, per the project page)
Phase III Future Park in the December 2015 Long-Range Property Management Plan (estimated lease termination 2022, a date that has passed)

Variety of active recreation zones; under the freeway, compatible 'noisy' active recreation (goals from the 1998 Design for Development and 2000 Infrastructure Plan, as summarized in OCII's November 2024 deck)

open_questions: No design, program or budget amount for P9 specifically was found: every source read treats P7 and P9 together, and the park program (skate park, pickleball, ballfield) is described as 'anticipated'. No P9-specific schematic design was found.

Dates conflict slightly between sources: Rec and Park's background text says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028', while its schedule gives construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030, and OCII's November 2024 deck shows transfer to Rec and Park at the end of 2028 upon completion. The milestones above use the schedule table.
Which design team was selected (the August 2025 update said by mid-October 2025) was not found. Contractor not found.
'Bare and graded with construction equipment visible' in the geometry notes is an imagery observation; no source read says so.
The P7/P9 boundary in the geometry is a straight line drawn by this project; no source read draws or states it.
